notes.title: Thank You Alphas!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello friends!
[/h2]

Thank you for showing interest and signing up to the Alpha Program. We have nearly 100 interests in a short period which is crazy! Wishlists are close to 100! A small first milestone! 

This post is to let you know that we have a demo build and are internally testing it with a few closed testers before making it available to you all. 

While I believe there will be many bugs and improvements to be made from when you see, I'd like the first impression to be our best effort! 

[h3]For now, here's a Monster coming soon![/h3]
